name: app-flight-search-phone-on-black-dust-dune-with-research-blurb
title: Dark Flight Search Phone on Dust Dunes
whatItIs: A lavender page with a research blurb in a soft circle above a black rounded panel where a dark flight search phone stands among dunes of white dust particles under a starry speckle, showing a route card, Search Flights button and an Airfrance flash offer.
whatItMeans: The dust dunes give a cinematic, otherworldly stage that contrasts with the friendly blue UI.
techniques: Particle dunes as a rendered landscape
Dark UI with a blue gradient button
Phone standing upright like a monolith
Pale lavender page framing a black panel

vocabulary.definition: A landscape built from thousands of tiny dots.
A device standing upright like a monument.
A dark rounded panel set on a light page.
